welcome.text:
🎉 I'm ready! I automatically forward messages from your channels and groups to wherever you want them. Just tap a button below – no commands to remember.
Version: v{version}
cmd.start.text:
👋 Welcome! I automatically forward messages from a channel or group to another chat – if you like, only the ones that really matter to you. What I can do for you: ✅ Forward messages automatically ✅ Let through only messages with certain words ✅ Replace unwanted words with your own ✅ Filter images, videos and files ✅ Save and transfer your settings Your first forward is set up in under a minute. Just tap a button below.
Version: v{version}
cmd.help.text:
❓ Help You operate me entirely with buttons. Send /start to see the main menu. Set up a new forward Tap “Set up a new forward” in the main menu. You pick where the messages come from, where they should go and what may arrive. Done. Change an existing one Tap “My forwards” in the main menu and pick one. There you can pause it, manage filter words, set up text replacements or delete it. Filter words Decide which messages get through – either only those containing your words, or everything except those. Text replacement Swaps parts of the text before the message reaches you – for example remove someone else's promo and put your own note in. For power users All former commands still work, for example /bind, /add, /replace, /list_rule, /settings, /changelog. They are simply no longer listed in the menu.
💡 Lost? /start always takes you back to the main menu.

menu.help.text:
❓ How it works 1. Set up a forward You pick where the messages come from and where they should go. You choose both from a list. 2. Decide what arrives Either everything – or only messages containing certain words. You can just as easily sort out messages containing certain words. 3. Done From now on every matching new message lands in the target chat automatically. You can pause or restart any forward at any time.
💡 Everything works with buttons. No commands to remember.

login.needed.text: 🔐 First connect your Telegram account So I can read along in your channels and groups, I need to connect to your Telegram account once. It takes a minute: enter your phone number, confirm the code from Telegram, done.
login.phone.ask:
🔐 Step 1 of 2: phone number Send me the phone number of your Telegram account – with country code.
Example: +4915112345678
login.phone.invalid: That number doesn't look right Please send it with country code, for example +4915112345678.
login.code.ask:
🔐 Step 2 of 2: code Telegram just sent you a code – check your Telegram messages. Important: put {prefix} in front of it, otherwise Telegram invalidates the code straight away.
Example: {prefix} 12345
login.code.missing_prefix: The code needs a word in front Please send it as {prefix} 12345. Without that word Telegram spots the code in the chat and invalidates it immediately.
login.code.invalid: That code is wrong Please check it and send it again as {prefix} 12345 – or request a new one.
login.code.expired: The code has expired Just request a new one.
login.password.ask:
🔐 Almost there: your password Your account is additionally protected by a password (two-step verification). Send it with {prefix} in front. I delete your message immediately and store the password nowhere.
Example: {prefix} MyPassword
login.password.missing_prefix: The password needs a word in front Please send it as {prefix} YourPassword.
login.password.invalid: That password is wrong Please try again with {prefix} YourPassword.
login.done: ✅ Account connected Signed in as {name}. From now on I can read along in your channels and groups and forward messages.
login.cancelled: Cancelled Without a connected account I can't read any messages. You can start the sign-in again at any time.
login.api_invalid: The credentials don't match API_ID and API_HASH in the configuration don't belong together. Please contact the operator.
login.flood_wait: Too many attempts Telegram is throttling the sign-in. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.

repeat.text: 🔁 Repeat a post {status} The bot sends the most recently forwarded post to the target chat again at a fixed interval, so it doesn't slip out of sight. Earlier copies stay where they are.
repeat.status.waiting: It starts as soon as the first post has been forwarded.
repeat.custom.ask:
✏️ Your own interval Send me after how many minutes the post should be sent again.
Example: 45
repeat.custom.invalid: That wasn't a number Please send just the number of minutes, for example 45.
repeat.custom.out_of_range: That doesn't fit Please pick a number between {min} and {max} minutes.
paid.text: ⭐ Paid posts {status} When a post in the source chat sits behind a paywall, the bot puts a paywall in front of it again in the target chat. Important: this only works if the connected account is allowed to see the post itself – so it bought it or belongs to the channel. Otherwise Telegram only hands over the blurred preview and just the text gets forwarded. Telegram also accepts paid posts in channels only, not in groups.
paid.status.same_as_original: Currently the same price as the original.
paid.ask:
⭐ Your own price Send me how many stars the post should cost in the target chat.
Between {min} and {max} – example: 50
paid.invalid: That wasn't a number Please send just the number of stars, for example 50.
paid.out_of_range: That doesn't fit Please pick a number between {min} and {max} stars.
settings.info.text: ℹ️ What the switches mean Basics • Active – Turns this forward on or off. • Sent by – Bot: posts arrive under the bot's name (the bot must be admin in the target channel). My account: posts arrive under your name (your account must be admin in the target channel). Protected channels and paid posts are always re-uploaded. • Mode – Forward: sends a copy to the target. Edit: changes the original message instead. What gets through • Filter – Block words: everything passes except posts containing your filter words. Allow words: only posts containing your filter words pass. • Filter words act as – Sets whether your word list counts as a block list or an allow list. • Also check sender name – Includes the sender's name in the word check. How the post looks • Text replacement – Replaces words or text by your rules. • Text format – Markdown or HTML for formatting. • Link preview – Show, hide, or follow the original for link previews. • Link to original – Appends a link to the source post. • Show sender / Show time – Adds the original's name or time. Flow • Delete original – Deletes the post in the source chat after forwarding. • Comment button – Adds a button to the comments section. • Delayed sending / Wait time – Waits the set seconds before sending. • Keep in sync – Carries later edits of the original over to the target. Under "+ More" • Copy … – Transfer settings, filter words or text replacements to another forward. • Clear all … – Empties the respective list. • Delete forward – Removes this forward entirely. • Design the … line – Sets how the sender, time and link line look. • Reverse block / allow – Flips the effect of the respective list.

onboard.welcome.text: 👋 Hi! I'm a forwarding bot: I automatically forward messages from Telegram channels or groups to other chats. You can filter, replace text, add delays and more. 📅 5 days free trial 💶 then from ~10 €/month – paid directly in Telegram with Stars. Because I use one bot per customer, you need your own personal bot. Tap below and I'll notify the operator – you'll receive the link to your own bot shortly.
onboard.how.text: ❓ How it works 1️⃣ You tap Request my bot 2️⃣ The operator sets up your personal bot in a few minutes 3️⃣ You get the link – open the bot – sign in with your Telegram account (all inside the chat) 4️⃣ Done! You can start right away. The first 5 days are free. After that, you buy your subscription right inside the bot with Telegram Stars. No credit card, no data sharing.

Step 4 – send in this chat: /anlegen {id} YOUR_TOKEN_HERE I'll then automatically build the container, start it and notify the customer.
